item.title: expo/skills: A collection of AI agent skills for working with Expo projects and Expo Application Services

item.title: Anthropic's Internal Systems Breached by an AI Agent in 12 Hours! Meeting Records, Employee Salaries, and Internal Model Discussions Accessed

haydenschmitty/floorplan: See how your app actually fits together. An interactive, plain-English map of your codebase, drawn by Claude
item.description: Floorplan is a tool where Claude reads a codebase and draws an interactive, plain-English map of how its parts, files and web requests connect.

item.title: ruvnet/RuView: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and…
item.description: RuView uses commodity WiFi signals to detect people, measure breathing and heart rate, and monitor rooms without cameras or wearables.

item.title: hmjz100/LinkSwift: A JavaScript Tool for Getting Download Links from Cloud Drives. Modified from 'Cloud Drive Direct Link Download Assistant', Supports Eight Cloud Drives: Baidu Netdisk / Alibaba Cloud Drive / China Mobile Cloud / China Telecom Cloud / Xunlei Cloud Drive / Quark Netdisk / UC Netdisk / 123 Cloud Drive

item.title: misshexa66/OunceCake: Tool to dump unencrypted romFS and exeFS for Switch 2 games
item.description: OunceCake is a tool that dumps unencrypted romFS and exeFS files from Switch 2 games, pulling them over FTP from your own console.

item.title: MOE to pilot full-day model at 2 kindergartens in 2027, roll out to all MOE kindergartens by 2030
item.description: MOE will pilot a full-day kindergarten model at two kindergartens in 2027 and roll it out to all its kindergartens from 2028 to 2030.

item.title: Emulate the 486 in Your Browser
item.description: A browser-based emulator by Jan de Jager recreates an Intel 80486DX2-66 PC, running FreeDOS and games like DOOM.

item.title: Google to preview crypto custody security system as AI threats grow
item.description: Google's Multi-Party Compute service, in private preview, splits private-key fragments across environments to help institutions secure crypto transfers; commercial availability planned for early 2027.

item.title: AI agents hacked Anthropic, maker of arguably the most capable AI models for cyberdefense
item.description: Cybersecurity startup Cathedral says AI agents reached Anthropic's internal sales, HR and IT data through third-party software, though Anthropic disputes how deep the breach went.

item.title: Investors brace for a hawkish hold and tech on tap
item.description: Investors await the Federal Reserve's decision, expected to keep rates unchanged, alongside tech earnings from Alphabet and Microsoft.

item.title: Lennox earnings missed by $0.52, revenue topped estimates
Labcorp Holdings Non-GAAP EPS of $4.78 beats by $0.14, revenue of $3.81B beats by $50M, raises FY guidance

item.title: Dollar steady ahead of Fed decision; focus on UK budget
item.description: The dollar held near a two-week high ahead of the Federal Reserve's rate decision, while sterling awaited the UK's first budget.

item.title: Malaysia says it seized ~$12.11M worth of AI chips this month, as authorities close in on a syndicate suspected of smuggling through the country's main airport
item.description: Malaysian customs seized about 49.5 million ringgit ($12.11 million) of advanced AI chips this month as authorities close in on a suspected smuggling syndicate.

item.title: HDB cuts 1,200 planned homes, retains more greenery at Maju Forest and Gillman Barracks after public feedback
item.description: HDB has revised plans for Maju Forest and Gillman Barracks, cutting about 1,200 homes and retaining more greenery after public feedback. The sites are now expected to yield about 11,000 homes over the next decade. Why it matters: The revised plans include about 9,500 public homes and 1,500 private units, with taller blocks planned.

item.title: IT vendor lists massive $60 million AI supercomputer on eBay with 300 racks of decommissioned GPUs
item.description: A seller has listed a 300-rack AI supercomputer on eBay for $59.7 million, packing 9,600 Nvidia A100 GPUs and 4,200 AMD EPYC Rome processors.

item.title: More greenery retained in Maju Forest, Gillman Barracks under revised plans
item.description: HDB's revised plans for Maju Forest and Gillman Barracks will build 11,000 homes over a decade, about 1,200 fewer, with more greenery retained.

item.title: Research: professional analysts followed AI agents' randomly assigned "leans" on subjective analytical decisions 86% of the time; 77% used the agents' arguments
item.description: In a study of 50 professional analysts using Claude Code, participants followed AI agents' randomly assigned leans on subjective decisions 86% of the time.

item.title: Mapletree Logistics Trust Q2 DPU inches up to S$0.01816
item.description: Mapletree Logistics Trust posted a Q2 distribution per unit of S$0.01816, up 0.1%, with distributable income up 0.9% to S$93.3 million.

item.description: Apple is expected to announce new high-end touchscreen MacBook Pro models today, possibly named 'MacBook Ultra', using M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.

item.title: ‘Don’t panic’: Marcos vows to defend Philippine peso after slide to record low
item.description: Marcos vowed to keep defending the Philippine peso after it hit a record low of 64.20 per US dollar, as oil prices soar.

item.title: Singapore stocks inch up with local bank gains; STI up 0.02%
item.description: The Straits Times Index rose 0.02% to close at 5,397.91 on Oct 28, with local banks gaining.

item.description: Macmillan staff told WIRED that NOA, an AI assistant introduced at the publisher in January 2024, was unhelpful and was later killed.

item.title: Quoting Terk Terkowitz
item.description: Terk Terkowitz, in an Amazon engineering update, says work where AI does not help is a finding worth documenting, not a failing.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI might be building the future, but someone else may own it
item.description: The article argues frontier AI labs like Anthropic and OpenAI may not capture most of the value they create, despite heavy losses.

item.title: Meta launches Muse AI agent in Singapore to help users shop, plan travel and manage emails
item.description: Meta's Muse personal AI agent is available in Singapore, able to carry out tasks like shopping, email management and travel planning via connected apps.

item.title: SGX needs still-tougher governance rules to attract the smart money
item.description: SGX RegCo and the Corporate Governance Advisory Committee opened a joint consultation on governance code and listing rule changes, open until Jan 27.

item.description: Malaysian customs seized about 49.5 million ringgit ($12.11 million) of advanced AI chips this month while investigating a suspected smuggling syndicate.

item.title: Bank of America is begging customers not to hand their passwords to AI assistants
item.description: Bank of America has emailed customers warning them not to share online banking usernames and passwords with external services, including AI agents. The bank says any resulting liability would fall on the customer. Why it matters: As AI assistants grow more autonomous, handing them bank logins could make customers liable for activity they trigger.

item.title: Banks should review financing ties with firms linked to haze: MAS
item.description: MAS says banks should review financing ties with clients linked to haze, limiting exposure or cutting ties with those found to have clearly breached environmental laws. Banks should also engage linked clients to understand their role. Why it matters: Singapore banks' lending to palm oil and forestry groups is under scrutiny over transboundary haze.

item.title: Peak XV leads $100m round in AI analytics startup Hex
item.description: Peak XV led a $100 million round in AI analytics startup Hex, which rewrote its product from scratch; its earlier version had over 2,500 customers.

item.description: An unauthenticated firmware update endpoint in Intelbras IP cameras lets anyone on the local Wi-Fi knock them offline; fixed in firmware R.260804.

item.description: Aurender's $4,700 NH10 network hub, marketed to audiophiles, has eight gigabit ports, with four copper ports using seven electrical filtering stages.

item.title: Kospi surges 7% as SK Hynix earnings fuel AI stock rebound
item.description: South Korea's Kospi rose 6.6% after SK Hynix reported a sevenfold profit jump and announced 60 trillion won in shareholder returns.

item.description: Apple will open pre-orders Wednesday for five new products, including its first touchscreen MacBook Pro models, with availability from November 6.

item.description: Secrets management firm Infisical raised $40 million at a $600 million valuation to expand tools letting AI agents reach sensitive systems without holding credentials.

item.description: JR East uses a remotely controlled robot with a chainsaw arm to trim branches encroaching on rail lines, and could become autonomous later.

item.description: The post argues getting good at using AI takes long-term skills built through practice, not just tricks, and supplying the right context.

item.description: Senator Elizabeth Warren asked Dario Amodei of Anthropic for "exhaustive responses" by November 3 to four pages of questions on existential risks in its S-1.

item.description: The paper proposes EvidenceConnect, which synthesizes training data from zoomed views of related image regions to train VLMs to connect visual evidence.

item.title: aa1143/NamiGPT: Build GPT-2 from scratch in PyTorch, step by step
item.description: NamiGPT. 零基础入门大模型（LLM）的基础教程. 从零手写 GPT-2，一行行看懂大模型是怎么工作的. 图文教程 · 快速开始 · 在线可视化 · 作者 𝕏. 不需要大模型基础，会一点 Python、懂矩阵乘法这样的线性代数基础就够了。我们用 PyTorch 从零手写一个 GPT-2，加载 OpenAI 官方权重，跑通推理和文本生成。. 不调用任何现成的 Transformer 模块，模型代码 gpt2/model.py 不到 200 行. 用一个 3 个词的例子「猫吃鱼」，从分词一路推到文本生成，每篇都配可运行脚本. 和 HuggingFace 官方实现逐项对齐，测试保证结果一致. 学之前，先看这两份可视化. Why it matters: A hands-on walkthrough for readers following LLMs who want to see how GPT-2 works in code.

item.title: Houston millionaires on building wealth and business advice from houston's rich
item.description: Several Houston residents interviewed in person, including a business owner of 22 years and an energy-sector entrepreneur, with no net worth stated by them. Their advice: 1. Find a business that pays you recurring income every month, instead of chasing one-time sales. 2. Save money early, since compound interest is the greatest force in the universe. 3. Figure out what you are good at and do that, rather than following your passion. 4. Do not walk into a room asking what they can do for you; ask how you can serve them. 5. Pay attention to red flags instead of ignoring them because you want something so badly. Why it matters: Touches advice from founders and the wealthy.
